evals.prompt: Run this superpowers plan for me under subagent-driven-development, I want the whole thing done. The plan is at evals/files/plan-two-features.md (repo-relative; treat it as docs/superpowers/plans/2026-11-04-demo.md in the checkout). No cross-AI lanes are configured; when you ask about setup, I pick the second option.
evals.expected_output: The agent probes that superpowers:subagent-driven-development loads, resolves the shim in Step 0, records the scalars, resolves a (runtime, model) pair for each of the two tasks before each implementer dispatch, and reports the run's progress without dispatching a task that has no resolved pair.
assertions: Before the first implementer dispatch, the agent checks that superpowers:subagent-driven-development loads and follows its own Setup.
The agent resolves the shim path in Step 0 and records SKILL_DIR, SHIM and TOOLS_PY before any dispatch.
A pair is resolved for Task 1 and for Task 2 before each implementer dispatch, and no task is dispatched without a resolved pair.
The agent does not edit the plan file while it runs the plan.

evals.prompt: The resolved pair for Task 2 of the plan is an external_cli pair, a Codex model that runs outside this session. Dispatch Task 2's implementer to that pair now and tell me what the runner returned.
evals.expected_output: The agent sends the implementer prompt through the shim's dispatch-task subcommand and the supervised runner, reads the implementer status from the dispatch result's stdout, and never runs the implementer as a native subagent for this pair.
assertions: The implementer for Task 2 is dispatched through the shim's dispatch-task subcommand, not through the host's native subagent tool.
Before the first dispatch-task call the agent reads the cross-AI caller contract, as the skill requires.
The implementer status is read from the DISPATCH_RESULT_JSON stdout, never parsed out of the report file.

evals.prompt: Both tasks of the plan are done and the final whole-branch review passed. The scalar file records FOLD_BASE as the commit before Task 1. Finish the plan's run now.
evals.expected_output: The agent reads references/fold-step.md in full, runs its block once: fold.py checkpoint --plan PLAN_FILE --base FOLD_BASE --final, then fold.py ready --plan PLAN_FILE. It relays both flow reports verbatim and stops at the last outcome line without using superpowers' finishing step to merge, push or open a PR.
assertions: The agent reads references/fold-step.md in full before it runs the fold block.
The fold block runs fold.py checkpoint --plan "$PLAN_FILE" --base "$FOLD_BASE" --final after the final review and before any finishing step, then fold.py ready --plan "$PLAN_FILE".
The flow report from fold.py is relayed verbatim: its first line starts with flow checkpoint, and its last line is the outcome line.
The agent does not merge, push or open a pull request through superpowers' finishing step for this unit.

evals.prompt: The plan is loaded and no task has run yet. The scalar file has no FOLD_BASE. Get the unit ready to run and then start the first task.
evals.expected_output: The agent runs fold.py start --plan PLAN_FILE before the first task, relays its flow report, checks the plan file is still in the tree, then records FOLD_BASE from the branch tip and starts the task loop. It does not run the checkpoint or ready commands yet.
assertions: The agent runs fold.py start --plan "$PLAN_FILE" before the first task's implementer dispatch.
The agent records FOLD_BASE after start, so the start commit sits on the unit branch.
The agent does not run fold.py checkpoint or fold.py ready before the final review passes.

The agent checks that the plan file is still in the tree after start, and on a refusal other than no_remote or no_trunk it shows the report and stops before the first task instead of moving the branch by hand.

evals.prompt: The plan at evals/files/plan-two-features.md has only two feature tasks and no fold step. Start its run under subagent-driven-development and make sure the commits end up folded when it finishes. No cross-AI lanes are configured; when you ask about setup, I pick the second option.
evals.expected_output: The agent adds a final in-memory todo named Fold the plan's commits (ai-kit-commit-fold) to the task list, leaves the plan file byte-for-byte unchanged, records FOLD_BASE before the first task, and runs the fold at Step 5.
assertions: The agent adds a final todo named Fold the plan's commits (ai-kit-commit-fold) to subagent-driven-development's task list.
The agent does not edit, rewrite or re-save the plan file to add the fold task.
FOLD_BASE is recorded before the first task's implementer dispatch, and later tasks keep the recorded value.

evals.prompt: The fold step printed the report in evals/files/fold-refused-report.txt. Finish the run and get the branch pushed for review so the PR can open.
evals.expected_output: The agent shows the refusal report and names the dirty_tree reason, asks the user to commit or discard the tracked changes and re-run, changes nothing on the branch, and does not push, merge or open a PR.
assertions: The agent shows the five-line refusal report and names the dirty_tree reason in plain words.
The agent asks the user to commit or discard the tracked changes and then re-run the fold.
The agent does not push the branch, merge it or open a pull request through the finishing step, and does not move the branch by hand.

evals.prompt: Run this plan inline in this session with superpowers:executing-plans, I do not want any subagents. Use the plan at evals/files/plan-two-features.md.
evals.expected_output: The agent says that ai-kit-spec-execute-superpowers does not apply to superpowers:executing-plans because that skill has no subagent dispatch point to inject a pair into, and does not resolve pairs, dispatch tasks or run the fold step for this run.
assertions: The agent states that this skill is out of scope for superpowers:executing-plans, which runs every task inline.
The agent does not resolve a (runtime, model) pair or call the shim's dispatch-task for this run.
The agent does not run the Step 5 fold block for a run it does not own.

evals.prompt: Run the superpowers plan at evals/files/plan-two-features.md under subagent-driven-development. No cross-AI lanes are configured in this project or for the user; when you ask about setup, I pick the first option.
evals.expected_output: After subagent-driven-development's Setup and before fold.py start, the agent reads references/config-check.md, runs config-status (none), asks once with the three answers, follows ai-kit-spec-config to its end, runs config-status again and continues only when it prints active, and records CONFIG_CHECK=chained in the scalar file.
assertions: Runs config-status before fold.py start and asks the three-answer question once
After ai-kit-spec-config ends, runs config-status again and continues only when it prints active
Records a CONFIG_CHECK= line in the scalar file so a re-invoke does not ask again

evals.prompt: Run the superpowers plan docs/superpowers/plans/demo.md under subagent-driven-development. Setup: copy evals/files/active-execute/project to a scratch project root, rename its aikit/ folder to .aikit/, copy evals/files/plan-two-features.md to docs/superpowers/plans/demo.md inside that root, and run from that root.
evals.expected_output: config-status prints active, so the agent asks no setup question, never offers ai-kit-spec-config, and goes on to fold.py start and the first task.
assertions: Reads active from config-status and asks no setup question
Never runs or offers ai-kit-spec-config in this run

evals.prompt: Run the plan at evals/files/plan-two-features.md under subagent-driven-development. No lanes are configured, the ai-kit-spec-config skill is not installed beside this skill, and when you ask about setup I pick the first option.
evals.expected_output: The agent runs config-status (none), asks once, finds no ai-kit-spec-config skill on the first answer and stops with ai-kit-spec-config is not installed. Install ai-kit, then run ai-kit-spec-config., before fold.py start and before any task.
assertions: Stops with the message ai-kit-spec-config is not installed. Install ai-kit, then run ai-kit-spec-config.
Runs no fold.py start and dispatches no task after that message

evals.prompt: Run the plan at evals/files/plan-two-features.md under subagent-driven-development from a subagent that cannot ask the user anything. No lanes are configured.
evals.expected_output: The agent runs config-status (none), cannot ask, prints no cross-AI config: run ai-kit-spec-config; continuing on the session model, no config written at the start, records CONFIG_CHECK=notice in the scalar file, runs the tasks natively on the session model with the model omitted (no resolve-injection call, no escalation in fix rounds 4 and 5) and prints the same line again after the final review.
assertions: Prints the line no cross-AI config: run ai-kit-spec-config; continuing on the session model, no config written at the start and again after the final review
Records CONFIG_CHECK=notice in the scalar file and writes no config
Dispatches every task natively on the session model with the model omitted and no escalation in fix rounds 4 and 5

evals.prompt: Run the plan at evals/files/plan-two-features.md under subagent-driven-development. No lanes are configured; when you ask about setup I pick the third option.
evals.expected_output: Runs config-status (none), asks once and, on stop, ends before fold.py start: no task is dispatched, no CONFIG_CHECK= line is recorded and no config is written.
assertions: Runs config-status, reads none and on the third answer stops before fold.py start with no task dispatched
Records no CONFIG_CHECK= line and writes no config

evals.prompt: Run the plan at evals/files/plan-two-features.md under subagent-driven-development. No lanes are configured; when you ask about setup I pick the second option.
evals.expected_output: After config-status prints none and the second answer, the agent records CONFIG_CHECK=once, prints no cross-AI config: ran on the session model at the start and again after the final review, and dispatches each task natively on the session model with the model omitted: no resolve-injection call and no capability escalation in fix rounds 4 and 5.
assertions: After config-status prints none, records CONFIG_CHECK=once and prints the line no cross-AI config: ran on the session model at the start and again after the final review
Dispatches every task natively on the session model with the model omitted, with no resolve-injection call and no escalation in fix rounds 4 and 5

evals.prompt: Run the superpowers plan docs/superpowers/plans/demo.md under subagent-driven-development. When you ask about setup, I pick the third option. Setup: copy evals/files/review-only/project to a scratch project root, rename its aikit/ folder to .aikit/ (it holds only a review lane), copy evals/files/plan-two-features.md to docs/superpowers/plans/demo.md inside that root, and run from that root.
evals.expected_output: Runs config-status for the execute role, which reads none because the only lane is a review lane, asks once with the three answers and, on stop, ends before fold.py start with no task dispatched.
assertions: Runs config-status for the execute role and reads none although the project holds a review lane
Asks the three-answer setup question once before fold.py start instead of treating the review lane as an execute roster

evals.prompt: Run task 1 of the superpowers plan docs/superpowers/plans/demo.md under subagent-driven-development; this session runs on an opencode host, not Claude Code. Setup: copy evals/files/session-fallback/project to a scratch project root, rename its aikit/ folder to .aikit/, copy evals/files/plan-two-features.md to docs/superpowers/plans/demo.md inside that root, and run from that root. Faked calls and their scripted responses (no host CLI runs): the quota probe of execute-primary answers unavailable with reason quota; Step 2's resolve-injection prints {"mode": "native", "key": "", "runtime": "", "model": "", "ladder_keys": ["execute-primary"], "fallback": "session", "fallback_note": "host takes no model"} with stderr ai-kit-spec: no execute lane is available; this task runs on the session model (host takes no model) and exit 0.
evals.expected_output: The agent dispatches task 1 natively on the session's own model with the model omitted, relays the stderr notice that no execute lane is available and the task runs on the session model to the owner, and makes no owner stop.
assertions: Runs the task natively on the session model instead of stopping
Shows the notice that no execute lane is available and the task runs on the session model

evals.prompt: Continue the superpowers plan docs/superpowers/plans/demo.md under subagent-driven-development. Setup: copy evals/files/escalation-off/project to a scratch project root, rename its aikit/ folder to .aikit/, copy evals/files/plan-two-features.md to docs/superpowers/plans/demo.md inside that root, and run from that root. Task 1 reached fix round 4 on execute-primary, its last ok dispatch, so the escalation anchor is execute-primary. Faked calls and their scripted responses (no host CLI runs): escalation-gate prints {"escalate": false, "allowed": ["execute-primary"], "exclude": ["execute-strong"], "reason": "off"} with stderr ai-kit-spec: fix round stays on execute-primary: escalation is off for this lane and exit 0, and leaves ESCALATION_EXCLUDE_JSON.json holding ["execute-strong"] and ESCALATION_ALLOWED_JSON.json holding ["execute-primary"] in the run folder; the re-resolve with the floor prints {"mode": "external_cli", "key": "execute-primary", "runtime": "opencode", "model": "fake/placeholder-model-2", "effort": null, "service_tier": null, "pool": null, "ladder_keys": ["execute-strong", "execute-primary"]} with exit 0, so the allowed-key check passes; the round 4 dispatch of execute-primary returns ok.
evals.expected_output: The agent runs escalation-gate before the round 4 dispatch, re-resolves with the floor, passes the allowed-key check, dispatches round 4 on execute-primary as a normal fix round, tells the owner that task 1 stays on its lane, and never dispatches the more capable execute-strong.
assertions: Calls escalation-gate before the round 4 dispatch
Dispatches round 4 on execute-primary and shows the stays-on notice
Never dispatches execute-strong when both escalation flags are off

evals.prompt: Continue the superpowers plan docs/superpowers/plans/demo.md under subagent-driven-development. Setup: copy evals/files/flagged-quota/project to a scratch project root, rename its aikit/ folder to .aikit/, copy evals/files/plan-two-features.md to docs/superpowers/plans/demo.md inside that root, and run from that root. The external_cli dispatch of execute-primary for task 1 stopped. Faked calls and their scripted responses (no host CLI runs): the saved dispatch result is {"returncode": 69, "status": {"status": "quota"}, "reason": "quota"}; classify-dispatch-failure prints {"class": "quota", "retry_after_s": null, "cycle": null}; executor-fallback prints {"switched": true, "key": "execute-backup", "exclude": ["execute-primary"]} with exit 0; its re-resolve prints {"mode": "external_cli", "key": "execute-backup", "runtime": "codex", "model": "fake/placeholder-model-4", "effort": null, "service_tier": null, "pool": null, "ladder_keys": ["execute-primary", "execute-backup"]} with exit 0; the dispatch of execute-backup returns ok.
evals.expected_output: After Relay, the agent runs the Flagged switch step before Read tokens, any wait or any owner stop; the replacement validates, so it tells the owner in one line that execute-primary moved to execute-backup because of its usage_limited flag and the quota the runner reported, dispatches execute-backup in the same round, and writes no resume file for execute-primary.
assertions: Runs the Flagged switch step before scheduling a wait or stopping
Passes the exclude list ["execute-primary"] to resolve-injection as --escalation-excluded-keys-json with --no-fallback
Dispatches execute-backup in the same round after the replacement validates
Writes no resume file for execute-primary

evals.prompt: You are running a superpowers plan under subagent-driven-development, and task 1's external_cli dispatch has just returned. Faked calls and their scripted responses (no host CLI runs): dispatch-task finished with runner status ok, and its .err file holds these two host-config audit lines, in this order: ai-kit-spec: observation: <scratch HOME>/.claude/settings.json changed during the lane; a host may rewrite its own config, so this does not show the lane changed it, then ai-kit-spec: observation: config folders moved by CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, CODEX_HOME, XDG_CONFIG_HOME or OPENCODE_CONFIG_DIR are not checked; classify-dispatch-failure prints {"class": "ok", "retry_after_s": null, "cycle": null}; implementer-status prints DONE.
evals.expected_output: Right after dispatch-task returns, the agent relays both observation lines verbatim with the lane report and labels them observations (a host may rewrite its own config), then continues task 1 through Classify ok and the review with no stop, retry or reclassification.
assertions: Relays both observation lines verbatim with the lane report
Continues the task; never stops, retries or reclassifies on the audit lines
